text: The minimum option is 140$ /mo for only 15min/week. Of course I need help but who has the budget for that!?
author: Chris Daniels
developer_reply: We totally understand—getting support shouldn’t feel out of reach. We’re actively working on more affordable options, and we’d love to explore what might be possible for you. Feel free to reach out at support@shimmer.care—we’re here to help however we can. 💛
